standard_prerequisites.name: Nodes, validity, trees and universal trees of the SEM forcing
standard_prerequisites.statement: A node is an M-finite sequence of pairs of a bit and an M-finite R-transitive subset of X_a; it is valid when each block lies in the corresponding side of the colouring; a tree is a downward closed set of nodes and it is universal when every non-leaf node can be extended on one of the two sides of every finite partition of a sufficiently long initial segment; the author's own definitions are retained at source lines 819-829 and 853-861.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes all the objects of the counted lemma, namely the condition, the Sigma^0_1 formula, the finite maximal universal tree and the notion of a node satisfying the formula.

standard_prerequisites.name: Valid leaves and the extension they produce
standard_prerequisites.statement: Every M-finite universal tree has a valid leaf, and a valid node yields an extension of the underlying condition; both statements are retained with this card at source lines 880-882 and 841-844.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof starts from a valid leaf of the tree and takes the extension that the leaf produces, so both statements are used as the first two steps.

standard_prerequisites.name: The family of sets X_a, compactness and the class of partitions
standard_prerequisites.statement: The conditions are built from the family of sets X_a indexed by integers, with G almost contained in X_b for the relevant b; the class of partitions of X_b satisfying the property obtained from maximality is a non-empty Pi^0_1(Y plus X_b) class, and by definition of the family there are indices c and d partitioning X_b inside that class.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof needs compactness to pass from the partitions of every initial segment to a partition of the whole X_b, and then the family of sets to realise that partition by two of its members.

core_obligations: Apply the valid-leaf lemma to get a valid leaf of the finite maximal universal tree, and note that the tree satisfies the formula, so the formula holds at the set of the leaf and at the corresponding index (source lines 899-900).
Apply the extension lemma for valid nodes to obtain a bound b such that the pair consisting of the set of the leaf and b extends the original condition (source line 901).

Use maximality of the universal tree: for every level there is a two-partition of the initial segment such that no side admits a block extending the leaf inside the tree while keeping the formula true (source lines 903-904).

Note that the choice of the bound b makes every M-finite R-transitive subset of either side of X_b a legitimate block, so the property obtained from maximality holds for these blocks on every initial segment, giving the displayed property (P) (source lines 906-909).

Apply compactness to obtain a single two-partition of the whole of X_b satisfying property (P), and observe that the class of such partitions is a non-empty Pi^0_1(Y plus X_b) class (source line 911).

Use the definition of the family of sets to find indices c and d realising a partition of X_b in that class, use that G is almost contained in X_b so that G is almost contained in one of the two parts, say the first, and conclude that the extension forces the formula at the index of the leaf and its negation at the next index, which is the statement of the counted lemma (source lines 911-912).

proof_roadmap.step: Take a valid leaf and the extension it produces.
Turn maximality of the tree into the property (P) on every initial segment.
Apply compactness, realise the partition by two sets of the family and conclude the forcing statement.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:sem-wf-finite-tree-forcing（源 893-897 行，证明 898-912 行）：给定条件、Σ⁰₁ 公式与一棵 M-有限极大泛树，存在扩展 (τ,c)≤(σ,a) 与 q 使 (τ,c) 同时强制 φ(G,q−1) 与 ¬φ(G,q)。关键操作不是例行核验：先从有效叶出发取其给出扩展 (π(ν),b)（899-901 行）；再把「极大性」翻译成对每个高度存在的二分划，使任何合法块都不能在保持 φ 为真的前提下延拓该叶，从而得到逐高度的性质 (P)（903-909 行）；随后必须用紧致性把逐高度性质提升为 X_b 的整个二分划，并注意到该分划类是非空的 Π⁰₁(Y⊕X_b) 类，借定义 X 族的性质把它实现为两个 X_c、X_d 对 X_b 的分划（911 行），最后由 G ⊆* X_b 得 G 落在其中一侧，才得到所宣称的强制关系。难点在于两次跨「有限/无穷」的过渡（极大性→逐高度、逐高度→紧致性）与把抽象分划类落到模型内具体集合；原文位置在证明的 903-911 行。
